title: Kimi adds 3D Make: Kimi drives Blender and CAD tools to build models, scenes and games
summary: Kimi now connects to Blender and CAD tools to create 3D models, assemble scenes and build games, available on kimi.ai and in Kimi Work. Replies are mostly curious; a few say it did not work for them or was not available to try yet.
